meaning.ur: Insulation impedance detection fail

causes.en: Insulation impedance detection failed.
causes.ur: Insulation impedance detection fail

causes.en: Moisture or dirt on the DC cables and PV modules lowers the insulation resistance.
causes.ur: DC taarein aur PV module par nami ya gandagi insulation resistance kam kar deti hai.

causes.en: Damaged or chewed cable insulation lets current leak to earth.
causes.ur: Damaged ya chuhe ne kaati hui cable insulation se current zameen mein leak hota hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the AC and PV supply before checking any cable.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi taar check karne se pehle inverter band karke AC aur PV supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check that the wire insulation is intact — look for cuts, burns or moisture on the AC and PV wiring and tighten the terminals.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke taaron ki insulation sahi hai — AC aur PV wiring par cut, jalan ya nami na ho aur sab terminal tight hon.

solutions.en: Dry and repair any damaged insulation, then restart; if the fault stays, the unit needs a technician.
solutions.ur: Insulation damage ho to use sukha karke theek karein, phir restart karein; fault rahe to unit ko technician ke paas bhej dein.

meaning.ur: Electric meter mein power nahi

causes.en: Electricity meter has no power.
causes.ur: Electric meter mein power nahi

causes.en: Meter supply wiring is loose or the meter fuse is blown.
causes.ur: Meter ki supply wiring dhili hai ya meter ka fuse udd gaya hai.

causes.en: Meter communication wiring fault or wrong meter model setting.
causes.ur: Meter ki communication wiring mein fault hai ya meter model ki ghalat setting hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter before checking the meter wiring.
solutions.ur: Meter ki wiring check karne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the status of the meter and its supply, and confirm the meter communication line is connected and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Meter ki haalat aur uski supply check karein, aur confirm karein ke communication line lagi hui aur sahi hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect or replace the meter supply or wiring, then restart the inverter and confirm the meter is read again.
solutions.ur: Meter ki supply ya wiring dobara lagayein ya badlein, phir inverter restart karein aur confirm karein ke meter phir se padha ja raha hai.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: Remote se band

causes.en: Remote shutdown.
causes.ur: Remote se band

causes.en: A remote shutdown command was sent from the app or monitoring system.
causes.ur: App ya monitoring system se remote shutdown command bheji gayi hai.

causes.en: Timer or scheduled shutdown is active in the settings.
causes.ur: Settings mein timer ya schedule shutdown chalu hai.

solutions.en: Check first that nobody switched the unit off from the remote or app.
solutions.ur: Pehle check karein ke kisi ne remote ya app se unit band to nahi ki.

solutions.en: Turn the unit back on from the remote and wait; if it stays off, restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Remote se unit dobara on karein aur intezaar karein; band hi rahe to inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If the unit switches off again by itself, check the remote wiring and the control board.
solutions.ur: Unit phir se apne aap band ho to remote ki wiring aur control board check karein.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: Frequency configuration match nahi

causes.en: Frequency configuration mismatch.
causes.ur: Frequency configuration match nahi

causes.en: Grid frequency setting in the menu does not match the local grid frequency.
causes.ur: Menu mein grid frequency ki setting local grid frequency se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Grid frequency standard was changed after a firmware update or site change.
causes.ur: Firmware update ya site change ke baad grid frequency standard badal diya gaya.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before opening the settings.
solutions.ur: Settings kholne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check in the menu that the configured frequency matches the local grid frequency, and measure the grid frequency with a meter to confirm.
solutions.ur: Menu mein check karein ke configured frequency local grid frequency se match karti hai, aur meter se grid frequency naap kar confirm karein.

solutions.en: Set the correct frequency, save and restart; if the fault remains, that setting may not suit this model.
solutions.ur: Sahi frequency set karke save karein aur restart karein; fault rahe to shayad yeh setting is model par lagu nahi hoti.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: Arc fault

causes.en: Arc fault.
causes.ur: Arc fault

causes.en: Loose MC4 connectors or loose terminal joints spark an arc.
causes.ur: MC4 connector ya terminal joint dhile honay se arc banta hai.

causes.en: Cracked PV module or damaged DC cable insulation causes arcing.
causes.ur: PV module ka crack ya DC cable insulation damage hone se arc banta hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the AC and DC supply immediately; an arc fault is a fire risk.
solutions.ur: Inverter foran band karke AC aur DC supply alag kar dein; arc fault ki wajah se aag lag sakti hai.

solutions.en: Look and listen for a burning smell, black marks or loose terminals on the output and DC wiring, and tighten or replace what is damaged.
solutions.ur: Output aur DC wiring par jalan ki boo, kaalay nishan ya dhile terminal dekhein-sunein, aur damage cheez tight ya badal kar dein.

solutions.en: Wait a while after the check and restart; if the alarm returns, stop and send the unit in for repair.
solutions.ur: Check ke baad thori der intezaar karke restart karein; alarm wapas aaye to ruk jayein aur unit repair ke liye bhejein.

meaning.ur: EPS overload 1.05 guna

causes.en: 1.05 times overload.
causes.ur: EPS overload 1.05 guna

causes.en: EPS load exceeds 1.05 times the rated capacity.
causes.ur: EPS load rated capacity se 1.05 guna zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many appliances are switched on at the same time on the EPS output.
causes.ur: EPS output par ek saath bohat zyada appliance chalu hain.

solutions.en: Turn off high-power loads before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karne se pehle bhaari load band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter and keep it below the EPS rating; start heavy appliances one at a time.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naapein aur EPS rating se neeche rakhein; bhaari appliance ek ek karke chalayein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the inverter keeps running without the overload alarm again.
solutions.ur: Restart karein aur confirm karein ke inverter dobara overload ki wajah se band nahi hota.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: EPS overload 1.25 guna

causes.en: 1.25 times overload.
causes.ur: EPS overload 1.25 guna

causes.en: EPS load exceeds 1.25 times the rated capacity.
causes.ur: EPS load rated capacity se 1.25 guna zyada hai.

causes.en: A motor or compressor on the EPS draws a heavy running current.
causes.ur: EPS par laga motor ya compressor bhaari running current khinchta hai.

solutions.en: Turn off high-power loads before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karne se pehle bhaari load band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter; at 1.25 times overload the load must be cut well below the EPS rating.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naapein; 1.25 guna overload par load ko EPS rating se kaafi neeche karna parega.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the inverter runs normally without the overload alarm.
solutions.ur: Restart karein aur confirm karein ke inverter overload ke baghair normally chal raha hai.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: EPS overload 1.5 guna

causes.en: 1.5 times overload.
causes.ur: EPS overload 1.5 guna

causes.en: EPS load exceeds 1.5 times the rated capacity.
causes.ur: EPS load rated capacity se 1.5 guna zyada hai.

causes.en: Several heavy loads were started together on the EPS output.
causes.ur: EPS output par kai bhaari load ek saath start kar diye gaye.

solutions.en: Turn off high-power loads before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karne se pehle bhaari load band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter; at 1.5 times overload remove the extra load completely before retrying.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naapein; 1.5 guna overload par dobara try karne se pehle extra load mukammal hata dein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the inverter runs normally without the overload alarm.
solutions.ur: Restart karein aur confirm karein ke inverter overload ke baghair normally chal raha hai.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: EPS overload self-lock

causes.en: Overload self-locking.
causes.ur: EPS overload self-lock

causes.en: EPS was overloaded repeatedly and the protection locked.
causes.ur: EPS par baar baar overload hua aur protection lock ho gayi.

causes.en: A motor or high inrush appliance draws a large starting current on EPS.
causes.ur: Motor ya high inrush appliance EPS par bohat zyada starting current khinchta hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the high-power load, the PV, the battery and the AC power before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle bhaari load, PV, battery aur AC power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the connected load against the inverter rating with a clamp meter and remove anything extra.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se lagay huay load ki inverter rating se nisbat dekhein aur extra cheez utaar dein.

solutions.en: Restore power step by step and restart the inverter; if it locks again, the unit needs service.
solutions.ur: Power qadam ba qadam on karke inverter restart karein; dobara lock ho to unit ki service zaroori hai.

meaning.ur: PV connection configuration ghalat

causes.en: PV connection configuration error.
causes.ur: PV connection configuration ghalat

causes.en: PV string count or connection type configured in the menu is wrong.
causes.ur: Menu mein PV string ki tadaad ya connection type ghalat set ki gayi hai.

causes.en: Panel model or quantity changed on site but the settings were not updated.
causes.ur: Site par panel model ya tadaad badli gayi lekin setting update nahi ki.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV and battery and restart the inverter before checking the connections.
solutions.ur: Connection check karne se pehle PV aur battery band karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the PV connection matches the configuration in the menu and that every string plug is tight and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke PV connection menu ki configuration se match karta hai aur har string plug tight aur damage free hai.

solutions.en: Correct any mismatch, save the setting and restart; if the fault stays, contact service.
solutions.ur: Koi ghulat theek karke setting save karein aur restart karein; fault rahe to service se rabta karein.

title.ur: Start hone ki state fail ho jaye (manual mein FAILL likha hai)

meaning.ur: Start ki state fail ho jana.

causes.en: Startup state failed.
causes.ur: Start ki state theek se na banna.

causes.en: Grid voltage or frequency is outside the start window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage ya frequency start window se bahar hai.

causes.en: DC bus has not reached the required level because PV or battery input is missing.
causes.ur: PV ya battery input na hone se DC bus zaroori level tak nahin pahuncha.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the AC, PV and battery supplies before retrying.
solutions.ur: Dobara try karne se pehle AC, PV aur battery supply band karke alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Wait a while and restart the inverter to see if it returns to normal, and check that DC and grid are present at the terminals.
solutions.ur: Thori der intezaar karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke woh normal ho jata hai, aur terminal par DC aur grid maujood hain — check karein.

solutions.en: If the start-up state fails again, the control board needs technician or repair centre inspection.
solutions.ur: Phir se start state fail ho to control board ka jaiza technician ya repair centre se karwa lena zaroori hai.

meaning.ur: PV1 ulta connection

causes.en: PV1 reverse connection.
causes.ur: PV1 ulta connection

causes.en: PV1 positive and negative leads are swapped.
causes.ur: PV1 ke positive aur negative wire ultay lage hain.

causes.en: Reverse-fitted MC4 connectors on the PV1 string.
causes.ur: PV1 string ke MC4 connector ultay lage hain.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV and battery and restart the inverter before touching the PV leads.
solutions.ur: PV ke taar chhoone se pehle PV aur battery band karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the positive and negative poles of PV1 with a meter and correct any reversed lead.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV1 ke positive aur negative pole ka connection check karein aur koi ulta taar theek kar dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect, restart and confirm PV1 is now recognised normally.
solutions.ur: Dobara connect karke restart karein aur confirm karein ke PV1 ab theek detect ho raha hai.

meaning.ur: PV1 voltage zyada

causes.en: PV1 voltage is too high.
causes.ur: PV1 voltage zyada

causes.en: PV1 open-circuit voltage is above the inverter limit — too many panels in the string.
causes.ur: PV1 ka open-circuit voltage inverter limit se zyada hai — string mein bohat zyada panel hain.

causes.en: Cold weather raises the PV voltage above the allowed range.
causes.ur: Sardi mein PV voltage allowed range se upar chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the PV before measuring.
solutions.ur: Naapne se pehle PV band karke alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the PV1 voltage with a meter, confirm it is inside the inverter input range and check the string size and connections.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV1 ka voltage naapein, confirm karein ke woh inverter input range mein hai aur string ki tadaad aur connection bhi check karein.

solutions.en: If it is too high, reduce the panels in that string and restart; if it stays high, call a technician.
solutions.ur: Voltage zyada ho to us string se panel kam karke restart karein; phir bhi zyada rahe to technician bulayein.

meaning.ur: Battery type ki configuration ghalat hona.

causes.en: Battery type configuration error.
causes.ur: Battery type ki setting ghalat hona.

causes.en: Battery type selected in the menu does not match the installed battery.
causes.ur: Menu mein chuna hua battery type installed battery se match nahi karta.

causes.en: Battery communication protocol was changed after an upgrade.
causes.ur: Upgrade ke baad battery communication protocol badal diya gaya.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV and battery and restart the inverter before checking the setting.
solutions.ur: Setting check karne se pehle PV aur battery band karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm in the menu that the battery type matches the installed battery.
solutions.ur: Menu mein confirm karein ke battery type lagay hui battery se match karti hai.

solutions.en: Correct the type, save and restart; if the fault stays, that battery may not be supported by this model.
solutions.ur: Type theek karke save karein aur restart karein; fault rahe to shayad yeh battery is model par support nahi karti.

meaning.ur: Battery voltage zyada

causes.en: Battery voltage is too high.
causes.ur: Battery voltage zyada

causes.en: Battery has been overcharged or a cell is unbalanced and reads high.
causes.ur: Battery overcharge ho gayi hai ya koi cell unbalanced hai aur reading zyada de rahi hai.

causes.en: Charging voltage is set too high in the settings.
causes.ur: Settings mein charging voltage bohat zyada set ki gayi hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the charging source and isolate the battery before probing.
solutions.ur: Probing se pehle charging source band karke battery alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery output voltage with a meter and confirm it is inside the normal range for that battery type.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery output voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke woh battery type ke mutabiq normal range mein hai.

solutions.en: If the voltage is too high, stop charging and have the charger or battery checked by a technician.
solutions.ur: Voltage zyada ho to charging band karke charger ya battery technician se check karwaein.

meaning.ur: BMS battery cell fault

causes.en: BMS battery failure.
causes.ur: BMS battery cell fault

causes.en: One cell has drifted out of range or gone weak.
causes.ur: Koi cell range se bahar chala gaya hai ya kamzor ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Cell sampling wire is loose so the BMS reads a wrong value.
causes.ur: Cell sampling wire dhili hai is liye BMS ghalat value padh raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the battery before any test.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi test se pehle inverter band karke battery alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the cell status and BMS display on the battery and note which cell reports the fault.
solutions.ur: Battery par cell status aur BMS display check karein aur note karein ke kaun sa cell fault de raha hai.

solutions.en: Contact the battery supplier for cell replacement or BMS service — do not open the battery yourself.
solutions.ur: Cell badalne ya BMS service ke liye battery supplier se rabta karein — battery khud na kholein.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: BMS communication fail

causes.en: BMS communication failure.
causes.ur: BMS communication fail

causes.en: Battery communication cable is loose or not fully seated.
causes.ur: Battery communication cable dhili hai ya mukammal nahi lagi.

causes.en: BMS address or protocol setting does not match the inverter.
causes.ur: BMS address ya protocol setting inverter se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before reseating the communication cable.
solutions.ur: Communication cable dobara lagane se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check whether the communication between the battery and inverter is normal — reinsert the plug and look for a broken wire or loose pin.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery aur inverter ke darmiyan communication normal hai — plug dobara lagayein aur tooti taar ya dhila pin dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart the system after reseating; if the fault stays, the cable or port needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Dobara lagane ke baad system restart karein; fault rahe to cable ya port badalna parega.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: Battery SOC kam

causes.en: Low battery SOC.
causes.ur: Battery SOC kam

causes.en: Battery has been discharged deeply and needs charging.
causes.ur: Battery gehrai se discharge ho gayi hai aur charge karne ki zaroorat hai.

causes.en: SOC calibration is wrong so the real charge differs from the reading.
causes.ur: SOC calibration ghalat hai is liye asal charge reading se alag hai.

solutions.en: Reduce or switch off heavy loads so the battery is not drained further.
solutions.ur: Battery ka aur discharge na ho is liye bhaari load kam ya band kar dein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery in time from the grid or PV and watch the SOC rise.
solutions.ur: Grid ya PV se battery ko waqt par charge karein aur SOC barhta huye dekhein.

solutions.en: If the SOC does not rise while charging, have the battery and charger checked.
solutions.ur: Charge karte waqt SOC na barhe to battery aur charger check karwaein.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: Battery current zyada

causes.en: High battery current.
causes.ur: Battery current zyada

causes.en: Load or charging current exceeds the battery limit.
causes.ur: Load ya charging current battery ki limit se zyada hai.

causes.en: Battery internal resistance has gone up so the current spikes.
causes.ur: Battery ka andarana resistance barh gaya hai is liye current spike karta hai.

solutions.en: Turn off part of the load before the battery current goes any higher.
solutions.ur: Battery current aur barhe usse pehle load ka kuch hissa band kar dein.

solutions.en: The load is too high — reduce it appropriately and check it with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Load bohat zyada hai — usay theek se kam karein aur clamp meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the current stays inside the normal range; if not, the unit needs service.
solutions.ur: Restart karein aur confirm karein ke current normal range mein rehta hai; na rahe to unit ki service zaroori hai.

source.title: Fronus X1-Genki series user manual (official PDF — FRONUS SOLAR ENERGY / Wasiq Traders copyright)

meaning.ur: BST1 mein software overcurrent chal jana.

causes.en: BST1 software overcurrent.
causes.ur: BST1 software overcurrent

causes.en: BST1 output current exceeded the software limit — the load is too heavy.
causes.ur: BST1 ka output current software limit se nikal gaya — load bohat bhaari hai.

causes.en: Short or low-resistance load on the BST1 output.
causes.ur: BST1 output par short ya kam resistance wala load laga hai.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supply before any probing.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi probing se pehle power band karke supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check that the correct SMCU upgrade file for this model is being used.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke is model ke liye sahi SMCU upgrade file istemal ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Contact after-sales for assistance with the software upgrade — a failed upgrade can leave the unit dead.
solutions.ur: Software upgrade ke liye after-sales se madad lein — fail upgrade unit ko band kar sakta hai.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before checking the meter wiring.
solutions.ur: Meter ki wiring check karne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check if the meter is connected and if the meter communication line works normally, and measure its supply with a meter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter laga hua hai aur uski communication line normal kaam kar rahi hai, aur meter se uski supply naapein.

solutions.en: Reconnect or replace the communication line, restart the inverter and confirm the meter is read again.
solutions.ur: Communication line dobara lagayein ya badlein, inverter restart karein aur confirm karein ke meter phir se padha ja raha hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect the CT plug, restart and confirm the CT reading appears; replace the CT if there is no reading.

meaning.en: Communication loss between inverter and battery management system equipment.

causes.en: Communication loss between inverter and battery management system equipment.
causes.ur: Inverter aur BMS ke darmiyan communication kho jana.

causes.en: Communication cable between inverter and BMS is loose or broken.
causes.ur: Inverter aur BMS ke darmiyan communication cable dhili ya tooti hai.

causes.en: BMS address or protocol setting does not match the inverter.
causes.ur: BMS address ya protocol setting inverter se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before checking the BMS connection.
solutions.ur: BMS connection check karne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the connection status between the BMS device and the inverter — reinsert the plug and look for a broken wire.
solutions.ur: BMS device aur inverter ke darmiyan connection check karein — plug dobara lagayein aur tooti taar dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart after reseating; if communication is still lost, the cable or port needs replacement by a technician.
solutions.ur: Dobara lagane ke baad restart karein; communication phir bhi kho jaye to cable ya port technician se replace karwana hoga.
